data.name: Sahih al-Bukhari
data.description: The most authentic book of hadith after the Quran, compiled over sixteen years.

data.name: Sahih Muslim
data.description: The second of the two most authentic collections, noted for its precise arrangement.

data.name: Sunan Abu Dawud
data.description: A collection focused on hadith of legal ruling, one of the six major books.

data.name: Jami at-Tirmidhi
data.description: Known for recording the grading of each hadith and the views of the jurists.

data.name: Sunan an-Nasa'i
data.description: The most rigorously screened of the four Sunan collections.

data.name: Sunan Ibn Majah
data.description: The sixth of the canonical collections, arranged by chapters of fiqh.

data.name: Muwatta Malik
data.description: The earliest surviving collection, combining hadith with the practice of Madinah.

data.name: Imam Nawawi's 40 Hadith
data.description: Forty-two hadith that between them carry the foundations of the religion.

data.name: Forty Hadith Qudsi
data.description: Sayings the Prophet ﷺ narrated from Allah, outside the wording of the Quran.

data.name: Forty Hadith of Shah Waliullah
data.description: Forty hadith selected by the scholar of Delhi on belief and conduct.
